Program / Stream: CLAT Undergraduate (BA LLB / BBA LLB Hons 5-Year Integrated)
Conducting Body: Consortium of National Law Universities (Consortium of NLUs)
Minimum Educational Qualification: 10+2 (Senior Secondary) or equivalent with at least 45% marks (40% for SC/ST candidates)
Age Criterion: No Upper Age Limit as per Supreme Court directions
Participating NLUs & Seats: 24 National Law Universities across India (3,400+ undergraduate seats)
Selection Mechanism: Merit rank in 120-question offline OMR entrance test followed by centralized NLU counseling
